# Built by pipeline/qa/frequency/make_study_lists.py from corpus counts of the dictionary candidates

# score = mean over the three corpora of (occurrences per million eojeol).  The candidates are four-syllable dictionary entries with a 성어-style definition. seongeo_review.tsv records the AI-drafted keep/drop decision for each of the top ~500 by score: ordinary compound nouns (국가대표, 돌연변이 ...) are dropped; the lists are the first 100 / 300 keepers by score.
# Columns: list, rank, text (display), source (pack of the entry: krdict = core, stdict, opendict),
#   ext_id + headword (the entry in that pack: the pack's own id and exact headword),
#   score, kowiki / kowikisource / opensubtitles = raw hit counts, note.
# seongeo100 is the first 100 rows of seongeo300; seongeo_learner = every krdict 성어 the review keeps, by score, then zero-count ones in 가나다 order.
